falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom saw lower highs and failed recovery attempts; a breakout to new highs breaks the structural similarity and suggests the 'bottom' was already in or this is a different regime entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated fear/uncertainty; sustained VIX compression below 14 would indicate fear has fully dissipated, contradicting the pattern of lingering volatility that characterized post-August 2024 bottom behavior and suggesting the market is in a complacent uptrend rather than a fragile bottoming phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously rises more than 3% from current levels
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of flight-to-safety in bonds with risk-on in equities is inconsistent with the August 2024 bottom, where yields and equities moved in correlated fashion (rates fell on recession fears, stocks fell with them); decoupling invalidates the macro regime match and suggests a soft-landing/goldilocks narrative that breaks the pattern
